title: Preview the ragged wrap's drape
notes: Opt into WAR_RAGGED_CLOTH_DRAPE=1 to preview outward folds and a softer hanging outline on the permanent ragged wrap. The woven-material preview remains independently selectable.
A new profile capture and geometry-only comparison keep the same material, saved body shape and gameplay camera, making the silhouette change visible without disguising it as texture detail.

The angular panels, thick waist band, rear opening and missing seams, fraying and cloth motion remain unfinished. Ordinary launches keep the shipped geometry; this preview does not clear the clothing or Phase 0 art gate.
